title: 第15章 入剑宗剑术天梯考验第16章 登天梯破纪录
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 高耸入云的天剑山，充斥着无尽冰冷的剑气。
山脚下。
秦易跟七长老驻足。
“天剑宗就在这山顶上。”七长老道：“每一个加入天剑宗的弟子，都要接受入门考核，成功通过，方可成为天剑宗的正式弟子，除非……”
秦易问道：“除非什么？”
七长老眼眸中，浮现出了一抹希冀神色，他看着天剑山上那纵横交错的剑气，自语道：“除非，拥有剑种，就可免去入门考核。”
说完后，七长老摇了摇头。
显然。
他可不认为，秦易能诞生剑种。
“剑种？”秦易愕然，下意识问道，“普通的还是先天的？”
七长老愕然，“你这家伙，居然还知道先天剑种？”
停顿了一下，他继续道：“当然是普通剑种，先天剑种整个罗云帝国乃至夕阳大陆历史上，都没有出现过，我甚至怀疑先天剑种压根就不存在，只不过是人们杜撰的而已。”
秦易咧嘴一笑，先天剑种事关重大，还是不宜暴露为好。
“好了，别乱想了，剑种可遇不可求，你没有剑种也没关系，只要在剑术天梯上，攀登到三十六层，就算成功。”七长老拍打了一下秦易的肩膀安慰道，“我观你之前使用木剑，剑术精妙，剑道基础很扎实，考核对你应该没有什么难度。”
顺着七长老的目光看去，赫然发现。
在前往天剑山的路上，有着一道由九十九个台阶组成的剑术天梯。
之间的。
剑术天梯之上，充斥着冰冷到极致的剑气。
每上一个台阶，剑气的威力就会加大。
到最后九十九层台阶上的剑气，能秒杀炼脉境强者。
“剑术天梯的记录是多少层？”秦易问道。
他想试试，拥有先天剑种，能否登顶。
七长老道：“目前为止，剑术天梯的记录，是由天剑宗首席大弟子刘玄保持，他当年入门考核的时候，一口气闯到了七十二层，惊动了我们副宗主。”
剑术天梯。
不但是入门考核，也是对弟子们剑道天赋测试。
“这不是七长老吗？怎么出去一趟，又收了一个弟子？”
突然间。
山脚下传来了一道公鸭子嗓音的声音。
七长老闻言，脸色瞬间阴沉下来，没好气的说道：“与你有什么关系？”
来人身穿布衣，白色的络腮胡子长满脸颊两旁，枯瘦的手掌，缺了一根手指头，他负手而立，目光从七长老身上，转移到秦易身上。
“小子，你是真勇啊，居然敢拜入七长老门下。”布衣老者撇嘴。
轰！
七长老暴脾气，直接释放剑气，要与布衣老者大战。
content_en:
The towering Tianjian Mountain is filled with endless cold sword energy.
At the foot of the mountain.
Qin Yi and the Seventh Elder stopped.
"The Heavenly Sword Sect is on the top of this mountain." The Seventh Elder said: "Every disciple who joins the Heavenly Sword Sect must undergo an entrance examination and successfully pass it before he can become an official disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect, unless..."
Qin Yi asked: "Unless what?"
There was a look of hope in the eyes of the seventh elder. He looked at the criss-crossing sword energy on Tianjian Mountain and said to himself: "Unless you have a sword type, you can be exempted from the entrance examination."
After finishing speaking, the seventh elder shook his head.
Obviously.
He didn't think that Qin Yi could give birth to a sword species.
"Sword type?" Qin Yi was stunned and asked subconsciously, "Ordinary or innate?"
The seventh elder was stunned, "You guy, you actually know the innate sword species?"
After a pause, he continued: "Of course it is an ordinary sword species. The innate sword species has never appeared in the entire Luo Yun Empire or even in the history of Sunset Continent. I even suspect that the innate sword species does not exist at all and is just made up by people."
Qin Yi grinned. The innate sword species was of great importance, so it was better not to expose it.
"Okay, stop thinking about it. Sword skills are rare. It doesn't matter if you don't have sword skills. As long as you climb to the thirty-sixth floor on the swordsmanship ladder, you will be considered successful." The seventh elder patted Qin Yi's shoulder and comforted him, "I saw that you used wooden swords before. Your sword skills are exquisite and your swordsmanship foundation is very solid. The test should not be difficult for you."
Following the seventh elder's gaze, he made a shocking discovery.
On the way to Tianjian Mountain, there is a swordsmanship ladder consisting of ninety-nine steps.
between.
The swordsmanship ladder is filled with extremely cold sword energy.
With each step you go up, the power of the sword energy will increase.
The sword energy on the last ninety-nine steps can instantly kill a strong person in the Pulse Refining Realm.
"How many levels are there on the Swordsmanship Ladder?" Qin Yi asked.
He wanted to try to see if he could reach the top with his innate sword type.
The seventh elder said: "So far, the record of the swordsmanship ladder is held by Liu Xuan, the chief disciple of the Tianjian Sect. During the entrance examination, he reached the seventy-second floor in one breath, which alarmed our deputy sect leader."
Swordsmanship ladder.
It is not only an entrance examination, but also a test of the disciples' swordsmanship talents.
"Isn't this the seventh elder? Why did you go out and accept another disciple?"
suddenly.
From the foot of the hill came the sound of a male duck's voice.
When the seventh elder heard this, his face instantly darkened, and he said angrily: "What does it have to do with you?"
The person who came was wearing cloth clothes, with a white beard covering both sides of his face. His skinny palms were missing a finger. He stood with his hands behind his back, and his eyes shifted from the seventh elder to Qin Yi.
"Boy, you are so brave, you actually dare to become the disciple of the Seventh Elder." The old man in cloth curled his lips.
boom!
The seventh elder lost his temper and released his sword energy to fight the old man in cloth.
title_en: Chapter 15 Entering the Sword Sect Swordsmanship Ladder Test Chapter 16 Climbing the Ladder and Breaking the Record
